changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: execute dbo.sp_executesql @statement = N'create or alter view [dbo].[ClientEnvironment] as select E.ClientID, C.Name as ClientName, C.PublicID, case C.State when 0 then ''PoC'' when 1 then ''Active'' else ''Inactive'' end as ClientState, E.ID as EnvironmentID, E.Status, E.DatabaseServerID, case E.EnvironmentLevel when 0 then ''NIGHTLY'' when 1 then ''CLIENTDEV'' when 2 then ''UAT'' when 3 then ''PROD'' when 4 then ''LEGACYDEV'' when 5 then ''ALTERNATE'' when 6 then ''LEGACYPROD'' end as EnvironmentLevel from Client C inner join Company E on E.ClientID = C.ID'
